### Reference: hooks

#### `hook`

function · `import { hook } from '@harness/sdk'`

Declare a hook. Defaults: order 100, timeout 1000 ms.

```ts
function hook(def: { description: string; order?: number; timeout?: Duration; }): HookDef;
```

Refers to: [`Duration`](#core-duration).

#### `HookDef`

interface · `import { HookDef } from '@harness/sdk'`

A system's user-message hook: adds information to a message before the LLM sees it.

```ts
interface HookDef {
  readonly description: string;
  /** Lower runs first. */
  readonly order: number;
  /** After this the message goes on without it. */
  readonly timeout: Duration;
}
```

Refers to: [`Duration`](#core-duration).

#### `HookImpl`

type · `import { HookImpl } from '@harness/sdk'`

A hook's implementation.

```ts
type HookImpl<Cfg = unknown> = (input: HookInput, ctx: SystemCtx<Cfg>) => Promise<HookContribution[]>;
```

Refers to: [`HookInput`](#core-hookinput).

#### `HookContribution`

type · `import { HookContribution } from '@harness/sdk'`

What a hook adds, with refs (the wire form, `HookBlock`, carries names).

```ts
type HookContribution =
| { type: 'text'; tag: string; text: string }
| { type: 'suggest-context'; items: Array<{ context: AnyContextRef; why?: string }> }
| { type: 'suggest-fns'; items: Array<{ fn: AnyFnRef; why?: string }> }
/** Load these now. */
| { type: 'load'; context?: AnyContextRef[]; fns?: AnyFnRef[] };
```

#### `hookBlock`

function · `import { hookBlock } from '@harness/sdk'`

A hook contribution on the wire.

```ts
function hookBlock(contribution: HookContribution): HookBlock;
```

Refers to: [`HookBlock`](#core-hookblock).

#### `HookRef`

interface · `import { HookRef } from '@harness/sdk'`

A handle to a user-message hook.

```ts
interface HookRef<N extends QualifiedName> {
  readonly ref: 'hook';
  readonly name: N;
}
```

Refers to: [`QualifiedName`](#core-qualifiedname).

#### `AnyHookRef`

type · `import { AnyHookRef } from '@harness/sdk'`

```ts
type AnyHookRef = HookRef<QualifiedName>;
```

Refers to: [`QualifiedName`](#core-qualifiedname).
